method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Stocks rise on AI-led earnings, France's 10-year bond yield hits 5%
Equities.reason: Headline captures the prevailing equity narrative: AI-led earnings are driving tech/market risk appetite (positive for equities), but the simultaneous rise in France 10-year yields introduces a macro/interest-rate headwind. Net effect scored positive with meaningful relevance due to multi-asset impl

Equities.title: Nasdaq leads Wall Street gains as SpaceX, Super Micro boost AI sentiment
Equities.reason: Reinforces the dominant positive AI leadership theme: strong results from AI-related names (SpaceX, Super Micro) are lifting Nasdaq and risk sentiment more broadly. High relevance as it signals a market-regime rally led by AI earnings momentum.

Equities.title: China Stocks Set for Bear Market as AI Trade, Policy Hopes Fade
Equities.reason: Significant negative signal for regional/global equities: fading AI/policy hopes and a sustained selloff push China into bear-market territory, increasing downside risk and reducing the breadth of the AI-led rally. High relevance given scale and potential spillovers.

Equities.title: Asian markets dip as investors weigh tech earnings, Gulf tensions
Equities.reason: Captures short-term risk-off pressure: investors are trimming positions on geopolitical (Gulf) tensions and mixed tech earnings. Moderate relevance as a near-term sentiment/volatility headwind that tempers the AI-led upside.

Rates.title: US Dollar Index hovers around 101.70 as sliding US bond yields counters Fed hike bets
Rates.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, struggles to gain any meaningful traction on Thursday, trading around the 101.70 region during the Asian session.
Rates.reason: Calls out sliding US bond yields directly; implies a Treasury rally (yields down) which is positive for the Rates asset class.

Rates.title: Long-End US Yield Hits One-Month Low as AI Fears Fuel Haven Bid
Rates.reason: Direct report of long-end Treasury yields falling to a one-month low driven by safe-haven flows — high-relevance, sizable positive for bond prices (yields down).

Rates.title: Treasuries Slide After Middle East Strife Report Spurs Oil Gains
Rates.reason: Reports of a Treasury selloff tied to geopolitical/oil risk — yields rising (negative for Rates) and a clear driver of bond market weakness.

Rates.title: French yields breach 5% amid Paris budget paralysis and nationwide unrest
Rates.reason: Significant move higher in French sovereign yields tied to domestic political stress — meaningful negative signal for European bond markets and risk to broader rates.

Rates.title: Japanese investors sell foreign bonds for fifth straight week, eye home market
Rates.reason: Flow story: sustained selling of foreign bonds by Japanese investors can exert upward pressure on yields abroad — a moderate negative for global bond markets.

Rates.title: BNP Paribas AM Builds Long-End JGB Bet on Steep Yield Curve
Rates.reason: Portfolio positioning toward long-end JGBs on a steepening view implies an expectation of higher long-end yields — negative for bond prices, moderate relevance.

Rates.title: BlackRock's Rick Rieder sees 'historic' opportunity in high-quality bonds
Rates.summary: Rick Rieder, BlackRock's CIO of global fixed income, lays out his expectations for the fourth quarter and where he sees the best opportunities.
Rates.reason: Major asset manager calling a buying opportunity in high-quality bonds supports demand for Treasuries/IG bonds — modest positive for Rates.

Rates.title: Housing is flashing warning signs just as the Fed weighs more interest rate hikes
Rates.summary: Housing data deteriorated further in September, according to separate reports Tuesday.
Rates.reason: Deteriorating housing alongside ongoing Fed rate considerations introduces ambiguity but the headline flags potential for further policy-driven rate volatility — modest negative for bond prices.

FX.title: Forex Today: US Dollar extends slide as US yields stretch lower
FX.summary: Here is what you need to know on Thursday, October 22:
FX.reason: Broad USD weakness driven by lower US yields is a primary FX driver today — this is a market/regime-level signal that supports EUR/GBP/AUD/CAD/JPY strength vs USD. High relevance because it frames cross‑currency moves and risk sentiment.

FX.title: Euro posts modest gains above 1.1200 despite French political unrest, fiscal worries
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades with mild gains near 1.1235 during the early Asian trading hours on Thursday. However, the potential upside for the major pair might be limited amid concerns over the political and fiscal outlook in France.
FX.reason: EUR showing mild strength vs USD in line with the broader dollar slide. Technical/fundamental piece with political constraints on upside — treated as lower‑relevance (technical/price forecast) contribution to the USD‑weakness narrative.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar gathers strength on elevated oil prices
FX.summary: The USD/CAD pair weakens to around 1.4025 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. The pair hits the lowest since September 21 as elevated crude oil prices underpin the commodity-linked Canadian Dollar (CAD) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Commodity‑linked CAD strength from rising crude is a clear USD‑cross FX flow driver (USD/CAD lower). High relevance because oil moves are directly transmitting into FX via Canada’s terms‑of‑trade/yield differentials.

FX.title: Australian Dollar: RBA expectations support Aussie against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Commerzbank’s Norman Liebke notes that rising RBA rate expectations have lifted the Australian Dollar (AUD), with markets now pricing a high probability of a hike by year-end.
FX.reason: Higher RBA hike odds support AUD vs USD via yield differentials — a direct central‑bank expectations transmission into FX. Moderate relevance: policy expectations are a meaningful but not singular market mover today.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Holds onto monthly high near 1.3410
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) reflects strength against the US Dollar (USD) on Thursday, trading firmly near the monthly high at around 1.3410 in the European trade.
FX.reason: GBP strength vs USD consistent with the dollar’s weakness; this is primarily a technical/price‑forecast piece so relevance is capped. It reinforces the broader GBP‑up narrative but is not a standalone macro driver.

FX.title: Surging sterling shakes off Britain's budget blues
FX.reason: Reuters commentary indicates a broader market regime in which sterling is outperforming despite domestic fiscal noise — a significant cross‑market narrative supporting GBP vs USD. Elevated relevance due to market‑wide implications for capital flows into GBP.

FX.title: Japanese Yen extends range play vs USD as focus remains on Fed, BoJ meetings next week
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair holds steady above the 158.00 mark during the Asian session on Thursday, extending its consolidative price action witnessed since the beginning of this month amid a combination of diverging forces.
FX.reason: USD/JPY is range‑bound ahead of key Fed/BoJ meetings — this caps any large JPY move today but makes the pair sensitive to policy surprises. Moderate relevance because BoJ/Fed are primary potential FX catalysts next week.

FX.title: Swiss Franc struggles as US Dollar declines on Fed rate pause expectations
FX.summary: USD/CHF loses ground for the third consecutive day, trading around 0.8230 during Asian hours on Thursday.
FX.reason: USD decline is transmitting into CHF crosses (USD/CHF down -> CHF stronger). Technical/flow note with capped relevance; useful as a secondary confirmation of USD weakness across safe‑haven FX.

FX.title: Indonesian Rupiah faces challenges amid higher oil prices, inflationary risks
FX.summary: USD/IDR extends its gains for the second successive day, trading around 18,070 during Asian hours on Thursday. The currency pair has seen upward momentum as the Indonesian Rupiah (IDR) faces pressure from rising global oil prices, which have heightened fiscal
FX.reason: USD/IDR strength (IDR weakness) reflects EMFX pressure from oil‑driven inflation/fiscal concerns — a localized EM negative vs the broader USD. Lower relevance because it's an EM‑specific flow, not a major global FX regime shift.

FX.title: Iran's IRGC warns US of wider response, says seven vessels hit
FX.summary: Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) navy warned response may extend to US bases in the region if Washington keeps urging vessels to cross a mined waterway, Reuters reported on Thursday.
FX.reason: Escalation risk in the Middle East raises safe‑haven flows that can lift USD/JPY and USD generally. This is a material geopolitical counter‑signal to the USD‑weakness theme and thus carries above‑average relevance for FX positioning.

Commodities.title: Gold drops over 1% as oil rally reinforces higher-for-longer rate outlook
Commodities.reason: Macro-driven negative for gold: oil-driven higher-for-longer rate expectations raise real yields and weigh on non-yielding gold. Reuters piece signals broad market drivers rather than idiosyncratic technicals, so assign elevated relevance.

Commodities.title: Oil Rises as Deadly Saudi Attack Fans Middle East Supply Fears
Commodities.reason: Direct supply-risk shock to oil: deadly attack on Saudi assets raises risk premium and near-term supply concerns, supporting higher crude prices. High relevance given immediate market-moving geopolitical supply implications.

Commodities.title: Oil: Risk premium supported by Gulf tensions – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil prices remain well supported as ICE Brent trades back above $110/bbl following new attacks on Saudi Arabia.
Commodities.reason: Analyst note reinforcing a persistent oil risk premium from Gulf tensions; supports the prevailing bullish oil regime. Multiple confirmations of the same narrative boost relevance.

Commodities.title: WTI rises above $97.50 due to drone attacks on Saudi, Russia
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) oil price halts its three-day losing streak, trading around $97.70 during Asian hours on Thursday. Crude oil prices climbed following a drone attack on Saudi Aramco’s Shaybah oil field that resulted in two casualties.
Commodities.reason: Immediate price move tied to supply disruption/drone attacks — positive for WTI. High intraday relevance given clear causal link between attacks and crude buying.

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Official EIA notice of potential Gulf production shut-ins — a tangible supply-side risk for US oil and natural gas, supportive for prices in the near term. Relevance elevated given source and physical supply implications.

Commodities.title: WTI Price Forecast: Advances above mid-$98.00s as bullish setup backs additional gains
Commodities.summary: West Texas Intermediate (WTI) – the benchmark US Crude Oil price – attracts fresh buyers on Thursday, climbing to the $98.70 zone during the Asian session. The commodity remains within striking distance of its highest level since September 15, touched earlier
Commodities.reason: Price-forecast/technical piece on WTI: bullish technical setup supports additional gains. Per rules, price-forecast items get capped relevance (technical focus rather than new fundamental information).

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD slips below $57.00 as surging oil fuels inflation fears
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) loses ground for the second successive day, trading around $56.80 per troy ounce during Asian hours on Thursday. Non-yielding Silver faces challenges as surging oil prices fuel inflation fears and boost expectations of a Federal Reserve
Commodities.reason: Technical/forecast note: silver under pressure from oil-driven inflation and Fed expectations. As a price-forecast technical piece, assign capped relevance despite clear downside signal.

Commodities.title: Santos Posts Record Quarterly Output on New LNG, Oil Projects
Commodities.reason: Higher LNG/oil output from Santos increases supply — structurally negative for natural gas and oil prices. Bloomberg report from a major producer signals meaningful incremental supply, warranting moderate relevance.

Commodities.title: Copper Declines as Tech-Stock Selloff Dulls Appetite for Risk
Commodities.reason: Demand-sensitivity hit: copper down on risk-off sentiment tied to a tech selloff, reflecting weaker near-term industrial demand expectations. Moderately relevant to base metals given macro-driven demand pressure.

Commodities.title: ‘Super’ El Niño may soon make your coffee super expensive
Commodities.reason: Climate-driven supply risk for coffee from a strong El Niño — positive for coffee prices. Weather-driven commodity supply shocks are high-relevance fundamentals for agricultural markets.

Commodities.title: U.S. pulls diplomats from Saudi Arabia as it reportedly readies Iran strikes after midterms
Commodities.summary: The U.S. ordered non-emergency staff out of Saudi Arabia after Houthi strikes on an airport and an oil field, reviving fears of a widening regional conflict.
Commodities.reason: Political/military escalation risk with direct transmission to oil markets via heightened Middle East risk premium and potential supply disruptions. Government actions (diplomatic withdrawals) increase near-term oil risk and market sensitivity.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin ETFs attract $1.08 billion in 3 days but it may not be enough for a steep rally
Crypto.reason: Material institutional inflows into Bitcoin ETFs are a clear adoption and liquidity positive for BTC. This reinforces the dominant narrative of institutional demand supporting higher Bitcoin valuations, so assign a strong positive direction and high relevance.

Crypto.title: Why centralized exchanges refuse to list legacy crypto tokens without explicit SEC immunity
Crypto.reason: Regulatory uncertainty (SEC exposure) is a meaningful headwind to listings and liquidity for legacy tokens. This increases listing friction and constrains altcoin flows — negative directional impact with elevated relevance for market structure and access.

Crypto.title: China seeks to seize 61,800 BTC tied to $5.7 billion fraud scheme
Crypto.reason: Large sovereign/legal claims on substantial BTC balances raise supply/liquidity and custody-risk concerns. This is a direct negative for BTC market sentiment and potential available float, so moderate-to-high relevance and negative direction.

Crypto.title: Solana’s biggest network change since 2020 is live. Here’s how users benefit
Crypto.reason: A large network upgrade that improves performance/utility is a clear positive for Solana (onchain usage, developer activity). This is an asset-specific adoption positive with meaningful relevance for SOL and ecosystem flows.

Crypto.title: Zcash developers confirm November date for upgrade that triples payment speed
Crypto.reason: A confirmed upgrade that materially improves payment speed is a positive technical/adoption catalyst for Zcash. It's asset-specific but actionable for market participants so assign a positive direction and moderate relevance.

Crypto.title: XRP Ledger bug fix moved to November after validator support dipped for two hours
Crypto.reason: A delayed bug fix and temporary validator support dip raises reliability and decentralization concerns for the XRP Ledger. This is a clear negative for XRP-specific technical risk and short-term sentiment.

Crypto.title: Bybit will look for big broker partnerships to take on Robinhood in the U.S.
Crypto.reason: Bybit pursuing large broker partnerships to expand U.S. distribution suggests increased retail/institutional access and competition — a positive for exchange-led flows and broader adoption. Moderate relevance for market access.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin risk management grows more popular as the 'just bet on price' era fades
Crypto.reason: Growing adoption of risk-management tools signals market maturation and could reduce tail volatility and speculative flows. Positive for institutionalization with modest relevance to near-term price direction.

Crypto.title: OCC's final rule to start fresh in weighing stablecoin rewards against GENIUS Act ban
Crypto.reason: Policy review around stablecoin rewards and potential conflicts with legislative bans is a regulatory-risk item for the stablecoin space and products built on top of them. Assign a modest negative direction with solid relevance to payments/stablecoin markets.

Crypto.title: Monero futures are again heating with leverage, raising volatility risks
Crypto.reason: Rising leveraged activity in Monero futures increases tail-risk and potential for liquidations/spillovers. It's a negative for risk management and volatility in privacy-coin markets, with moderate relevance to derivatives risk.

Crypto.title: Tether leads $15 million funding round for AI-focused payment startup Mural
Crypto.reason: Tether investing in an AI payments startup is a small adoption/partnership positive that signals stablecoin issuers moving into broader payments and fintech, but the funding size and immediacy limit relevance.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC sets agenda for AI forum, exploring trading and agentic finance
Crypto.reason: Regulatory engagement on AI in trading and 'agentic finance' may shape future market structure and automated trading in crypto; it's a low-immediacy positive (engagement > restriction) with modest relevance.
